_doc: Tess OS v0.2 roster config. The roster is TEN roles for every use case (personal, agency, organisation): the conductor (Tess, the main session, not an agent file) plus the nine dispatchable roles in universal_base, installed on EVERY starter path. Roles are defined by permissions, model tier and isolation, not by expertise. Expertise comes from the lens library (.tess/core/conductor/lenses/, index in docs/LENSES.md): lenses are never registered agents. A path's squad and orchestrators are intentionally empty; default_lenses only changes which lenses the conductor suggests first. See conductor/roster.md.

founders._description: For founders, solo operators, CEOs, strategists. Same ten roles; strategy and commercial lenses suggested first.

builders._description: For developers, indie hackers, technical founders, product teams. Same ten roles; product and engineering lenses suggested first.

operators._description: For agency owners, service-business operators, COOs, client-delivery leads. Same ten roles; operations and client-experience lenses suggested first.

coding-squad._description: For adopters using Tess OS purely as a coding-agent harness. Same ten roles; architecture and engineering lenses suggested first.
